discover.title: Find your Apple TV
discover.description: On the Apple TV open Settings > Remotes and Devices > Remote App and Devices and leave that screen showing, then press Submit.

progress.install: Installing the pymobiledevice3 runtime. This takes about a minute.

abort.runtime_check_failed: Could not check the pymobiledevice3 runtime: {error}
abort.discover_failed: Could not search for Apple TVs: {error}. Check the Apple TV is on and on the same network, then try again.
abort.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Keep the Apple TV on its pairing screen, check the PIN, and try again.
abort.already_configured: This Apple TV is already set up.

restart_and_wait.name: Restart and wait
restart_and_wait.description: Restart the Apple TV and return once it has gone down and come back, or fail after the timeout.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the Apple TV to come back.
